hasLogBoundvarpi.name: Data.hasLogBound_varpi
hasLogBoundvarpi.statement:
instance hasLogBound_varpi (v : D.Φ) (u) :
  D.HasLogBound u (v (P.ϖ D.s)) (ite u 12 10 * D.logX)

hasLogBoundrootDisc.name: Data.hasLogBound_rootDisc
hasLogBoundrootDisc.statement: instance hasLogBound_rootDisc (u) : D.HasLogBound u D.rootDisc (ite u 12 10 * D.logX)

IsChosen.name: Data.IsChosen
IsChosen.statement: def IsChosen (w : FinPlace D.E) := D.piGBar ∈ w.1

ChosenPlace.name: Data.ChosenPlace
ChosenPlace.statement: protected abbrev ChosenPlace i := {w : FinPlace _ // D.piGBar ∈ w.1 ∧ ↑(D.g i) ∈ w.1}

piGBarmulstar.name: Data.piGBar_mul_star
piGBarmulstar.statement: lemma piGBar_mul_star : D.piGBar * star D.piGBar = D.gProd

existscofactor.name: Data.exists_cofactor
existscofactor.statement: lemma exists_cofactor {i} : ∃ c : ℕ, D.piGBar * star D.piGBar = D.g i * c ∧ (D.g i).Coprime c

isChoseniff.name: Data.isChosen_iff
isChoseniff.statement: lemma isChosen_iff : D.IsChosen w ↔ ∃ i, D.IsChosen w ∧ ↑(D.g i) ∈ w.1

qeqg.name: Data.q_eq_g
qeqg.statement: lemma q_eq_g {i} {w : FinPlace D.E} : ↑(D.g i) ∈ w.1 → w.q = D.g i

existsresiduecharoforder.name: Data.exists_residue_char_of_order
existsresiduecharoforder.statement:
lemma exists_residue_char_of_order (h : D.IsChosen w) : ∃ T : MulChar (ResField w) ℂ, orderOf T =
  P.Mω D.s ^ 2

decla.name: Data.ω
decla.statement: def ω w := if h : D.IsChosen w then (D.exists_residue_char_of_order h).choose ^ P.Mω D.s else 1

orderOf.name: Data.orderOf_ω
orderOf.statement: lemma orderOf_ω (h : D.IsChosen w) : orderOf (D.ω w) = P.Mω D.s

omegazpowmulpoweqone.name: Data.omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one
omegazpowmulpoweqone.statement: lemma omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one {ψ} (n : ℤ) (h : ψ w = 1) : (D.ω ^ n * ψ) w ^ P.Mω D.s = 1

existscharhasWeight.name: Data.exists_char_hasWeight
existscharhasWeight.statement: lemma exists_char_hasWeight : ∃ μ, HasWeight μ (-a * D.w 0 ·) (D.ω ^ n)

Pair.name: Data.Pair
Pair.statement:
structure Pair where
  ν : AutChar D.E
  c : D.Φ → ℕ
  (ψ z) hasWeight : ν.HasWeight (-c ·) ψ
  ψ_eq_one w : ¬D.IsChosen w → ψ w = 1
  z_mem : z ∈ Set.Icc 1 D.t
  le_c v : z ≤ c v
  c_le v : c v ≤ 4 * D.b

rowParameter.name: Data.rowParameter
rowParameter.statement: def rowParameter v i := ite (i + 1 < D.k) (D.k / 2 - 1 - i : ℤ) (D.h₂ - D.w (i + 2 - D.k) v)

logLevelTarget.name: Data.logLevelTarget
logLevelTarget.statement:
def logLevelTarget := D.m * ((∑ v, .log (D.nominalWeight v)) / D.f) + (D.m - 1) * .log
  (D.gProd * D.rootDisc / (2 * .pi)) - 15 / 2 * D.logB

logLevelTargetmemIcc.name: Data.logLevelTarget_mem_Icc
logLevelTargetmemIcc.statement: lemma logLevelTarget_mem_Icc : D.logLevelTarget ∈ Set.Icc (D.m * D.logB) (29 * D.m * D.logB)

logNmemIcc.name: Data.log_N_mem_Icc
logNmemIcc.statement: lemma log_N_mem_Icc : .log D.N ∈ Set.Icc (D.m * D.logB) (30 * D.m * D.logB)

existspimulstar.name: Data.exists_pi_mul_star
existspimulstar.statement: lemma exists_pi_mul_star : ∃ π : 𝓞 D.E, π * star π = D.N

mulstar.name: Data.π_mul_star
mulstar.statement: lemma π_mul_star : D.π * star D.π = D.N

TameChar.name: Data.TameChar
TameChar.statement:
structure TameChar where
  toAutChar : AutChar D.E
  Q : Finset _
  (ψ) hasWeight : toAutChar.HasWeight 0 ψ
  ψ_eq_one : ∀ w ∉ Q, ψ w = 1
  star_notMem : ∀ w ∈ Q, star w ∉ Q
  coprime : (D.gProd * D.N).Coprime (∏ w ∈ Q, w.q)

levelNorm.name: Data.TameChar.levelNorm
levelNorm.statement: abbrev TameChar.levelNorm {D} (ϑ : @TameChar P D) := ∏ w ∈ ϑ.Q, w.q

Twist.name: Data.Twist
Twist.statement: structure Twist extends D.TameChar where psi_ne_one : ∀ w ∈ Q, ψ w ≠ 1

decld.name: Data.μ₀
decld.statement: def μ₀ := D.muFlat * (WeilData.upsilonU1 ^ (-D.h : ℤ) * D.χ) ^ j

liftChar.name: Data.liftChar
liftChar.statement: def liftChar ϑ j := D.μ₀ j * TameChar.toAutChar ϑ

liftTamePart.name: Data.liftTamePart
liftTamePart.statement: def liftTamePart ϑ (j : ℕ) := D.ω ^ (j : ℤ) * TameChar.ψ ϑ

hasWeightliftChar.name: Data.hasWeight_liftChar
hasWeightliftChar.statement:
instance hasWeight_liftChar {ϑ j} : (D.liftChar ϑ j).HasWeight (-D.w j ·)
  (D.liftTamePart ϑ j)

BlockIndex.name: BlockIndex
BlockIndex.statement: @[instance_reducible] def _root_.BlockIndex (S T : Type) | 0 => S | j + 1 => BlockIndex S T j ⊕ T

firstBlock.name: BlockIndex.firstBlock
firstBlock.statement:
def _root_.BlockIndex.firstBlock : ∀ j,
  S ↪ BlockIndex S T j | 0 => .refl _ | j + 1 => (BlockIndex.firstBlock j).trans .inl

equivSum.name: BlockIndex.equivSum
equivSum.statement:
def _root_.BlockIndex.equivSum (ν : S ≃ α) : ∀ j, BlockIndex S T j ≃ α ⊕ Fin j × T
  | 0 => ν.trans (.symm (.sumEmpty ..))
  | j + 1 => (Cardinal.eq.1 (by simp! [(BlockIndex.equivSum ν j).cardinal_eq]; ring)).some

instFintypeYT.name: instFintypeYT
instFintypeYT.statement:
instance _root_.instFintypeYT :
    ∀ j, Fintype (BlockIndex S T j) | 0 => ‹_› | j + 1 => @instFintypeSum _ T (instFintypeYT j) _

card.name: BlockIndex.card
card.statement:
@[simp] lemma _root_.BlockIndex.card : Fintype.card (BlockIndex S T j) = Fintype.card S + j *
  Fintype.card T

RowIndex.name: Data.RowIndex
RowIndex.statement: @[reducible] def RowIndex := D.shape.BesselIndex deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

Y.name: Data.Y
Y.statement: abbrev Y := BlockIndex D.RowIndex (Fin D.t) j

paramW.name: Data.paramW
paramW.statement: def paramW τ i := 2 * D.rowParameter τ (D.basisNumber i)

entrySign.name: Data.entrySign
entrySign.statement: def entrySign : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℤˣ | o + 1, 0, a => -entrySign o 0 a | o, j, a => (-1) ^ (o + a + min (a - o) j)

iteoddeqsubemod.name: Data.ite_odd_eq_sub_emod
iteoddeqsubemod.statement: lemma ite_odd_eq_sub_emod (y : ℤ) : ite (j % 2 = 1) (y - 1) y = y - j % 2

signsW.name: Data.signsW
signsW.statement: def signsW i := ite (D.posRank j ≤ D.basisNumber i) (-1 : ℤˣ) 1

chosen.name: Data.chosen
chosen.statement: def chosen (x : Σ i, D.ChosenPlace i) := x.2.1

G.name: Data.G
G.statement: abbrev G := ∀ x, GL D.RowIndex (ResField (D.chosen x))

goodTupleFamilies.name: Data.goodTupleFamilies

e.name: Data.e₀
e.statement: def e₀ := ∑ c ∈ D.goodTupleFamilies, tupleIdem D.RowIndex c

existsbranchingpairing.name: exists_branching_pairing
existsbranchingpairing.statement:
lemma exists_branching_pairing [Nonempty n] {l l' s t r} {σ : _ ⊕ Unit ≃ n'} (hσ :
  (s ⊕ᵥ r) ∘ σ.symm = t) (ht : t = 1) (h : IsHCParam κ e l') (h' : IsHCParam κ' e' (-l)) (hi :
  ∀ w x, (#{j | x < l' w j} - #{i | x < l w i} : ℤ) ∈ Icc 0 1) : ∃ B : Matrix _ _ ℤ, (∃ N : _ → ℤ,
  (∀ (S R : Type) [CommRing S] [StarRing S] [Field R] [CharZero R] (f : _ → S →+* R) g u v' v,
  weylRep κ' e' (g.1.map <| f ·) *ᵥ v' ⬝ᵥ B.map (↑) *ᵥ weylRep κ e ((U.block σ (g, u)).1.map <|
  f ·) *ᵥ v = (∏ τ, (u.1.map (f τ)).det ^ N τ : Rˣ) * v' ⬝ᵥ B.map (↑) *ᵥ v) ∧ (∀ τ, (N τ).natAbs ≤
  boxes κ (card n') + (e τ).natAbs) ∧ ∀ M, boxes κ (card n') ≤ M → ∀ v' v, ‖v' ⬝ᵥ B.map (↑) *ᵥ v‖ ≤
  ((M ^ M) ^ 3 :) * √(weylNormSq v') * √(weylNormSq v)) ∧ ∀ g, ∃ c, ∀ (V : Space E n s) [V.IsStd]
  (η : AlgForm n _ e') (φ : AlgForm _ _ e) u K [IsLevel K], ∫ x, ofAlgForm (-l) s η x *
  ofAlgForm l' t φ (G.reindex σ hσ (.sum (x, 1, u)) * (g, 1)) ∂V.quotMeasure = c / stdLevelIndex K *
  classIntegral stdRatPoints K fun h ↦ η.1 h ⬝ᵥ B.map (↑) *ᵥ φ.1 (U.block σ (h, u))

binders.name: hi
binders.type: ∀ w x, (#{j | x < l' w j} - #{i | x < l w i} : ℤ) ∈ Icc 0 1

gridSpace.name: Data.gridSpace
gridSpace.statement:
def gridSpace : ∀ o z i j, Space D.E _ (D.gridSigns z o i j)
  | 0, true, 0, 0 => ((D.spaceY 0).sum (signedSpace ..)).reindex (.refl _) D.gridSigns_zero.symm
  | 0, false, 0, j => D.spaceY j | _ + 1, _, 0, 0 => (gridSpace ..).neg | _, _, _, _ =>
    signedSpace ..

gridKernel.name: Data.gridKernel
gridKernel.statement: def gridKernel z i j := kernelPair (D.gridParam z 0 i j) (D.gridSigns z 0 i j)

GridForm.name: Data.GridForm
GridForm.statement: abbrev GridForm z a b := (gridSpace ..).Form (D.gridKernel z a b true)

gridChar.name: Data.gridChar
gridChar.statement:
def gridChar := D.liftChar (bif c then ϑ.pow (l + 1) else .one) (l + 1) *
  WeilData.upsilonU1 ^ ((Fintype.card n + (!c).toNat) / 2)

gridTamePart.name: Data.gridTamePart
gridTamePart.statement: abbrev gridTamePart := D.liftTamePart (bif c then ϑ.pow (l + 1) else .one) (l + 1)

triangleOrder.name: Data.triangleOrder
triangleOrder.statement: abbrev triangleOrder z ϑ n := Fintype.card (GL (D.GridIndex z 0 n) (D.triangleModulus z ϑ).ResRing)

NodeIndex.name: Data.NodeIndex
NodeIndex.statement: abbrev NodeIndex (p : Node) := D.GridIndex p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2

nodeLevel.name: Data.nodeLevel
nodeLevel.statement:
def nodeLevel p := if !p.1 ∧
  p.2.1 = 0 then ⊥ else (GeneralLinearGroup.map (n := D.NodeIndex p) (reduceToTriangle ϑ true)).ker

levelIndex.name: Data.levelIndex
levelIndex.statement: abbrev levelIndex z a b := ((nodeLevel ϑ (z, a, b)).index : ℂ)

gridLevelForms.name: Data.gridLevelForms
gridLevelForms.statement:
abbrev gridLevelForms i :=
  levelSpace ((gridSpace ..).formRep (D.gridKernel true 0 i true)) (principalLevel _ D.gridLevelGen)

isConjKernelPairgridKernel.name: Data.isConjKernelPair_gridKernel
isConjKernelPairgridKernel.statement: lemma isConjKernelPair_gridKernel (h : i ≤ D.m ∧ j ≤ D.m) : IsConjKernelPair (D.gridKernel z i j)

gridCharhasWeight.name: Data.gridChar_hasWeight
gridCharhasWeight.statement:
instance gridChar_hasWeight : (gridChar ϑ c l n).HasWeight (D.gridWeight c l n)
  (gridTamePart ϑ c l)

isEdgeFamilygrid.name: Data.isEdgeFamily_grid
isEdgeFamilygrid.statement:
lemma isEdgeFamily_grid {I} (ϑ : I → _) d {c l i' j'} (e : (c, l, i', j') = bif d then (z, i, i + 1,
  j) else (!z, j, i, j + 1)) (hi : i' ≤ D.m := by omega) (hj : j' ≤ D.m := by omega) : IsEdgeFamily
  (fun x ↦ gridChar (ϑ x) c l) (D.gridKernel z i j) (D.gridKernel z i' j') d (D.gridHarmonic 0 d c
  l ..)

binders.name: e
binders.type: (c, l, i', j') = bif d then (z, i, i + 1, j) else (!z, j, i, j + 1)

gridSpacediag.name: Data.gridSpace_diag
gridSpacediag.statement:
lemma gridSpace_diag h : D.gridSpace 0 _ j j =
  ((gridSpace ..).sum (signedSpace ..)).reindex _ (D.gridDiagEquiv_spec h)

gridSpacesubdiag.name: Data.gridSpace_subdiag
gridSpacesubdiag.statement:
lemma gridSpace_subdiag j : ∃ τ h, D.gridSpace 0 true j (j + 1) =
  (D.gridSpace 0 false (j + 1) j).reindex (.symm τ) h

pointDescent.name: Data.pointDescent
pointDescent.statement:
def pointDescent z b : D.GridForm z 0 (b + 1) →ₗ[ℂ] D.GridForm z 0 b := (triangleOrder z ϑ b : ℂ) •
  modDescent _ _ (gridChar ϑ (!z) b) (D.gridHarmonic 0 false (!z) b z 0 b 0 (b + 1))
  (inclusionDatum (triangleModulus z ϑ).ResRing) ..

iotaPlus.name: Data.iotaPlus
iotaPlus.statement:
def iotaPlus z b : D.GridForm z 0 D.m →ₗ[ℂ] D.GridForm z 0 b := if b < D.m then pointDescent ϑ .. ∘ₗ
  iotaPlus .. else Pi.single (M := (D.GridForm .. →ₗ[ℂ] D.GridForm z 0 ·)) _ .id b

descentMove.name: Data.descentMove

binders.name: y
binders.type: Matrix (D.GridIndex z a (b + 1)) (D.GridIndex z a b) (gridModulus ϑ).ResRing

liftMove.name: Data.liftMove

binders.name: y
binders.type: Matrix (D.GridIndex z (a + 1) b) (D.GridIndex z a b) (gridModulus ϑ).ResRing

gridChardet.name: Data.gridChar_det
gridChardet.statement:
lemma gridChar_det {n'} [Fintype n'] s (k : Kf D.E n') : (gridChar ϑ c l n).1 (G.det (s := s)
    (1, k.1)) = (gridModulus ϑ).charOfTamePart (gridTamePart ϑ c l) ((gridModulus ϑ).reductionK₀
  k).1.det

levelIndexequntwisted.name: Data.levelIndex_eq_untwisted
levelIndexequntwisted.statement:
lemma levelIndex_eq_untwisted (h : z ∨ a ≠ 0) : levelIndex ϑ z a b =
  Fintype.card (GL (D.GridIndex z a b) (D.gridModulus 1).ResRing)
